title: With a cock with a carra.
html_source: This phrase repeats itself frequently throughout the chapter, like a chorus in a song. It is an onomatopoeic refrain, almost percussive in its qualities yet at the same time one cannot reduce this refrain to merely its auditory qualities. Joyce is not refraining from being discrete about his choice of words here and the refrain is also sexual in its nature, especially when used in reference to the bar maids and Bloom’s desire for them.
